supporting_pages.title: Known limitations \_|\_ Transfer Appliance \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: If you anticipate ordering many appliances for a large transfer and cannot follow the limitations listed below, you must perform an initial proof-of-concept transfer with a single Transfer Appliance and representative data to ensure performance is suitable before you order multiple appliances.

Object Versioning Using Transfer Appliance with a bucket where object versioning is enabled may result in multiple versions of the same object being created and storage costs associated with these versions.

evidence_snippets: Multiple network connectivity options : Quickly move data from your devices to Transfer Appliance, using either a 10Gbps RJ45 interface or a 40Gbps QSFP+ interface.
Scalability with multiple appliances : You can scale your transfers by ordering multiple appliance to increase your transfer speed.
However, with Transfer Appliance, you can receive the appliance and capture 300 terabytes of data in under 25 days.
